notes:
Summary: HelmForge runs outsourced contact center platforms for retail + telco clients. Main ask = ensure automated agent-assist + ticket summarization remains usable during incident bursts and seasonal peaks.

Key constraints / requirements: 
- Workloads: multi-tenant chat + agent desktop feed; heavy repeated-context tickets (same KB articles reused). Primary flows: agent_assist (suggested replies, tool-call triggers), ticket_summarization (auto-shorten), and secure tool_calling into their CRM\/workflow engine.
- Spike profile: baseline ~1200 reqs/sec, predictable seasonal peaks (Black Friday windows) and irregular incident bursts. Expected stress tests: sustained 3 hour runs at 5x baseline and short 10–20 min spikes up to 8x. Operational requirement: <1% failed requests during 5x synthetic test; p95 generation latency target for agent_assist <= 400ms under normal, <= 1s under 5x; degrade to summary-only and non-blocking suggestions under extreme load.
- Routing/fallbacks: must support automated routing to quantized, lower-cost model variants when capacity constrained; fallback policy must avoid unsafe tool-calls (turn into dry-run or queued webhook).
- Caching: prefix/KV caching essential due to high repeated-context tickets. They want smart cache invalidation by ticket id.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency SLOs, tracing hooks, and per-prompt quality metrics.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 + ISO27001 required for enterprise customers; EU data residency for several clients; KMS/HSM for key storage; 7 year audit log retention for regulated telco accounts.

POC details / success metrics: 
- POC tests: 5x sustained at 3 hours (target pass), 8x short spike (stress), queue backpressure test with synthetic open agents; monitoring of failed tool-calls and fallback behaviour.
- Success: <=1% errors on 5x sustained, agent response usefulness score > 4/5 from QA panel, fallbacks convert tool-calls to queued actions with no data loss.

Commercial / process notes: 
- Interested in Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput; Private (VPC/on‑prem) option for regulated clients. Optimization add-on desirable to tune batching and quantization.
- "If we can't guarantee behaviour during Black Friday, we can't sell to retail clients" — Head of Product (quote on 2026-02-10 call).

Open questions for Redwood team: 
1) Exact on‑prem deployment package timeline and sysadmin install playbook.
2) HSM integration checklist and example audit logs format.
3) Can Redwood expose a per-tenant fallback policy that blocks tool-calls automatically at specified backpressure thresholds?
